design.decision: Bid higher on a hand whose side-suit junk just became trumps, and plan to ruff early with the new low [♠]s instead of throwing them away.
design.opponent: Revealed at Opening; opponents face a team that is short in side suits and trumps their winners, so they cash aces early and lead [♠] to draw trumps.
design.rationale: A directed version of the only big common winner (cb-become-spade). It turns about six of the team's worst cards ([2]-[4]) into trumps, never wastes a change on a card that was already a [♠] honor, and leaves the side suits short. Standalone, it gives a visibly stronger hand. It also feeds Low Cards, because trumping with a [4♠] is a low-card win. It is broader than the cut common cc-twos-to-spades on purpose, since the brief asks for more cards changed.
design.draftText: Opening: Every [2] through [4] your team holds becomes a [♠]

history.note: draft-uncommon: merged into ua-low-become-spades, the same design (signature) from another cluster; the amount sweep decides the number.
